verdict.rationale: Snyk documents bulk operations on several surfaces. The API & Web CLI can run operations on targets, scans, and findings in bulk by passing identifiers or applying a filter. The Remediation Agent offers `/snyk-batch-fix` to fix multiple issues at once from a coding assistant. The CLI's `--all-projects` flag tests and monitors many packages in one run. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on bulk semantics and limits, bulk actions in the core platform (e.g., bulk ignore or bulk project management) shown in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
